trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for REAL_ESTATE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- booking_amount: Handle token and booking amounts, allotment status and refund requests within RERA rules.
- site_visit_scheduling: Qualify a lead against real inventory and book a site visit with a named executive.

Business context:
- booking_amount: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.
- site_visit_scheduling: Indian developer and brokerage contact centre. Callers respond to listings, ask about availability, price and possession, and book site visits. Price and possession commitments are regulated claims.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [booking_amount]
  - Deduction truth: The deduction and refundable amount must be the ones the eligibility tool returns.
  - Eligibility first: No refund may be initiated before check_refund_eligibility has returned eligible.
  - No timeline promises: The processing time quoted must be the tool's, never an assurance of sooner.
  - Confirmed allotment: A confirmed allotment follows the agreement's cancellation terms, not the token policy.
  [site_visit_scheduling]
  - Price truth: Only a price returned by check_inventory may be quoted. No 'starting from' figure the tool did not return.
  - Possession claims: Possession may only be stated as the quarter the inventory record carries, never as a promise.
  - RERA disclosure: The RERA id must be stated when a project is discussed, when the tool returns one.
  - No investment advice: The agent must not advise whether a property is a good investment or predict appreciation.

Tools available to you (7): check_inventory, check_refund_eligibility, initiate_refund, lookup_booking, lookup_lead, schedule_site_visit, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: mr-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_inventory
model_visible_tools.description: List unsold units in a project with carpet area, floor, price and possession quarter.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the cancellation policy to a booking and return what is refundable.

model_visible_tools.name: initiate_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Start a refund against a cancelled booking.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_booking
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a booking's unit, amounts paid, allotment state and cancellation window.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_lead
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve a lead's stated budget, preferred configuration and prior visits.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_site_visit
model_visible_tools.description: Book a site visit slot with an assigned sales executive.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Keeps turns short -- rarely more than two sentences.
Pushes the agent to act rather than explain; skips pleasantries.
States the goal early and repeats it if the agent digresses.
Accepts a correct answer immediately and ends the call.

steps.purpose: Greet the customer and state the purpose of the outbound call.
steps.text: नमस्कार, मी lead LD-2009 च्या account holder शी बोलत आहे का? तुमचा पुढचा instalment due आहे, त्याबद्दल मी कॉल केला आहे.

steps.purpose: Confirm identity informally and express intent to cancel the booking.
steps.text: हो, मीच बोलतोय. मला instalment भरायचा नाहीये, माझं booking cancel करा.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the cancellation request and ask for a verification factor.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, मला समजलं की तुम्हाला booking cancel करायचं आहे. पुढे जाण्यापूर्वी, मला तुमची identity verify करावी लागेल. तुमचा registered pincode सांगू शकता का?

steps.purpose: Provide the pincode quickly, showing a hurried persona.
steps.text: माझा pincode 411045 आहे. जरा लवकर करा, मला घाई आहे.

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity using the provided pincode.
Return a verification failure due to unrecorded factor.

result.error: Factor 'registered_pincode' is not recorded for this customer.

steps.purpose: Explain the verification failure and request an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Explain the verification failure without inventing a cause and provide a valid recovery path.
steps.text: माफ करा, तुमचा pincode आमच्या record मध्ये update केलेला नाहीये. तुम्ही तुमचं registered name किंवा date of birth सांगू शकता का?
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant correctly identifies the verification failure and recovers by asking for a different allowed verification factor.

steps.purpose: Provide the registered name for verification.
Verify the customer's identity using the provided name.
Return successful verification.
Acknowledge successful verification and transition to checking booking details.
steps.text: धन्यवाद राहुल. मी तुमची booking details check करतो.

steps.purpose: Retrieve booking details for the verified lead.
Return booking details.
Share the booking reference and amount paid with the customer.
steps.expected_behavior: State the booking reference and amount paid exactly as returned by the tool.
steps.text: मला तुमचं booking reference BK-9009 मिळालं आहे. तुम्ही आतापर्यंत 300000 रुपये pay केले आहेत.
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant grounds its response strictly in the lookup_booking tool result.

steps.purpose: Confirm the details and ask for the refund amount.
steps.text: हो, बरोबर आहे. मी आज cancel केलं तर मला किती refund मिळेल?

steps.purpose: Inform the customer that refund eligibility is being checked.
steps.text: मी तुमची refund eligibility check करतो.

steps.purpose: Check refund eligibility and amounts.
Return refund eligibility details.
State the deduction and refundable amount.
steps.expected_behavior: State the exact deduction and refund amounts provided by the tool.
steps.text: Policy नुसार, 45000 रुपये deduction होईल आणि तुम्हाला 255000 रुपये refund मिळेल.
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant strictly uses the figures from the check_refund_eligibility result to inform the customer.

steps.purpose: Dispute the deduction amount.
steps.text: 45000 का cut करत आहात? हे खूप जास्त आहे.

steps.purpose: Explain the reason for the deduction based on the allotment status.
steps.text: तुमचं allotment provisional आहे, त्यामुळे cancellation policy नुसार हे deduction लागू होतं.

steps.purpose: Agree to the deduction and request immediate refund initiation, with an STT error.
steps.text: ठीक आहे, माझा refund लगेच सुरू करा.
steps.clean_text: ठीक आहे, माझा refund लगेच सुरू करा.
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक आहे, माझा refund लगेच चूरू करा.

steps.purpose: State the processing time and confirm before initiating the consequential action.
steps.expected_behavior: Quote the exact processing time from the tool and do not promise a faster timeline.
steps.text: Refund process व्हायला 14 days लागतील. मी आता refund initiate करू का?
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant grounds the processing timeline in the tool result and asks for final confirmation.

steps.purpose: Confirm the initiation of the refund.
Initiate the refund process.
Return the result of the refund initiation.
Provide the refund ID and confirm the final details.
steps.expected_behavior: Provide the refund ID, amount, and processing days exactly as returned by the initiate_refund tool.
steps.text: तुमचा refund initiate झाला आहे. तुमचा refund ID RF-8822 आहे आणि 14 days मध्ये तुम्हाला 255000 रुपये मिळतील.
steps.planner_rationale: The assistant confirms the successful transaction using only the data provided by the tool.

steps.purpose: Acknowledge the final confirmation and end the conversation.

ir.terminal_condition: Refund initiated with an id, amount and processing window.
